relevance_note: The paper pools previously published HA20 cases and tabulates each patient individually ("89 patients from 39 families with a genetic diagnosis of HA20", Table S1), giving every patient's TNFAIP3 variant and clinical features.
method_note: Every table span is copied from the paper Markdown; table row lines are quoted stripped of their leading spaces. Table S1 is one row per patient (Patient 1-89); its Family (Ref.) and Amino acid alteration cells are printed only on the first row of each family, so they were propagated to the other patients of that family (family_label_in_paper and source_reference_in_review). In the phenotype_checklist table the individual label span is the bare patient-number cell as printed, to keep the table readable; the fuller row quote is in the individuals and phenotypic_features tables. The '+'/'-' symbols of Table S1 are nowhere defined in the paper or its legend, so nothing is recorded as 'excluded': every '-' cell is 'not reported'. '/' cells (treatment, initial diagnosis, other manifestations) are likewise undefined and treated as 'not reported'/'/'. The paper never says which individual patients belong to the OTU+ZnF / OTU / ZnF groups, so group statements such as "Patients in the OTU group did not present with musculoskeletal disorders" could not be applied to any individual. Zygosity 'heterozygous' and pathogenicity 'loss-of-function' come from the cohort sentence about the named group of 89 patients; variant_type_as_stated is 'not reported' for all patients because the paper lists mutation classes only for the cohort as a whole, except patient 77 ('Deletion of exons 2-3' / "A large deletion mutation of exons 2-3 of TNFAIP3"). Checklist mapping of the paper's own column names: musculoskeletal disorders -> arthritis or arthralgia; autoimmune thyroid disorder -> autoimmune thyroiditis; ocular involvement -> uveitis or other ocular inflammation; recurrent respiratory tract infection -> recurrent infections; lymphadenopathy -> lymphoproliferation or lymphadenopathy; insulin-dependent diabetes -> type 1 diabetes; cytopenia / idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura / anemia -> cytopenia (autoimmune); interstitial lung disease -> interstitial lung disease; pericardial effusion and ascites -> pericarditis or other serositis; growth delay -> growth failure; CNS vasculitis and aseptic meningitis -> central nervous system involvement; recurrent urinary tract infections and repeated genital HSV infections -> recurrent infections; atrophic gastritis -> gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation; autoimmune hepatitis -> autoimmune hepatitis. Features named only in the Initial diagnosis column (psoriasis, Henoch Schonlein purpura, Graves' disease) were not mapped onto checklist items. In the converted file 'insufficiency' of patient 8's 'Aortic valve insufficiency' and patient 77's '2-3' are split across lines; values are given joined. Paper-internal inconsistencies: abstract gives the OTU+ZnF onset IQR as 1-10 while Table 1 gives '6 (1.165-7)'; the abstract gives p = 0.006 for the BD comparison while the Results give p = 0.001; Table S2 prints '30%(0/30)' for p.His636Glufs*55 and '2%(0/50)' for p.Arg439Glnfs*6; Table 3 prints '69(11/16)' for glucocorticoid; the text cites Table S2 where Table 3 is meant.
